name: Porto Kizomba Festival
description: Dance the week away at this international gathering for lovers of kizomba, bachata, and salsa. Featuring workshops, themed parties, and world-class DJs, it's a vibrant celebration of Latin dance culture.
longDescription:
The Porto Kizomba Festival is an annual international dance event dedicated to kizomba, bachata, and salsa. It brings together dancers and instructors from various countries for a multi-day program of dance education and social dancing. The festival aims to foster a global community around these dance forms, offering opportunities for skill development and cultural exchange within the Latin dance scene.

Attendees can expect a full schedule of dance workshops led by professional instructors, catering to different skill levels. Evenings feature themed parties with music provided by international DJs, allowing for social dancing until late. The festival takes place in Vila Nova de Gaia, across the Douro River from central Porto, providing a setting for a focused dance experience. The atmosphere is generally social and energetic, attracting individuals with a shared interest in partner dancing.

The festival runs from July 22, 2026. Specific ticketing information, including pricing and availability, will be released closer to the event date. Vila Nova de Gaia is accessible from Porto via metro (Jardim do Morro station), bus, or by walking across the Dom Luís I Bridge.
